nodes.label: Atelier Mobile Studio PWA
nodes.rationale: Progressive web app shell for the Interior Design RAG system. Uses Supabase auth (magic link OTP) and n8n webhooks as backend. Screens: landing, signin, home (studio), new-upload, new-style, new-generating, canvas, library, notifications, profile.

nodes.label: Supabase Magic Link Authentication
nodes.rationale: Uses supabase.auth.signInWithOtp for passwordless email authentication. detectSessionInUrl resolves the session from the URL hash access_token on return from email link.

nodes.label: n8n Webhook Backend
nodes.rationale: All AI operations routed through n8n webhooks at https://n8n.srv1649259.hstgr.cloud/webhook. Endpoints: /auth/me, /uploads/room-photo, /generate/orchestrated, /generate/edit, /generate/commit, /generations/session/:id, /generations/:id/export.

nodes.label: POST /generate/orchestrated Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Primary generation path. Single call handles retrieval + generation. Body: {upload_id, brief, style_tag, room_type, session_id}. Returns generation_id, output_url, refs_used.

nodes.label: Atelier Credit System
nodes.rationale: Draft costs 2 credits, edit costs 1 credit, commit costs 3 credits. Credits stored in localStorage and displayed in UI.

nodes.label: Canvas Screen (Session Workspace)
nodes.rationale: Main editing workspace showing current revision, revision rail, and shelf actions: Edit, Refs, Commit, Export.

nodes.label: Revision Chain (Draft/Edit/Commit)
nodes.rationale: Each session has ordered revisions of kinds: draft, edit, commit. Stored as {id, kind, url, parentId, createdAt, modelId}.

nodes.label: Interior Style Options
nodes.rationale: Supported styles: Scandinavian (pale wood, airy, restrained), Japandi (quiet, textural, warm minimal), Mid-century (teak, tapered, bold color), Traditional (carved, layered, rich tones), Industrial (steel, concrete, patina), Boho (rattan, weave, sun-faded).

nodes.label: Room Type Options
nodes.rationale: Supported room types: Bedroom, Dining, Kitchen, Mandir. Used to filter reference pool and guide generation prompt.

nodes.label: n8n Consolidated Workflow (220 nodes)
nodes.rationale: Single consolidated n8n workflow (ID: JbnB5CPdoqgCl75F) containing all 13 HTTP endpoints and 4 inlined sub-workflows. 220 nodes, 177 connections. Built by build_consolidated.py.

nodes.label: Three-Agent Orchestrated Generation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Agent 1 (Orchestrator): reads upload+brief, produces CRITERIA and PROMPT blocks plus fts_search_text. Agent 2 (Spatial-aware Retriever): picks 3 references by spatial/layout, style/materials, lighting/ambience. Agent 3 (Gemini): generates final image.

nodes.label: Spatial-Aware Reference Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Agent 2 uses caption_enhanced and spatial_signature JSONB fields to pick references matching 3D structural fit. Spatial signature keys: room_shape, depth_cues, ceiling_height, window_wall, light_direction, focal_wall, floor_visible_pct, symmetry, open_to.

nodes.label: FTS Candidate Pool (retrieve_candidates_text RPC)
nodes.rationale: Uses retrieve_candidates_text Supabase RPC (full-text search on caption_enhanced) instead of vector similarity scan. Falls back to quality-ordered unfiltered pool if FTS yields < 3 results.

nodes.label: wf_supabase_verify Sub-workflow
nodes.rationale: Verifies Supabase JWT tokens by calling GET /auth/v1/user on the Supabase project. ID: 56BlN6jqFkXVszX2. Returns {ok, user_id, email} or 401.

nodes.label: wf_save_generation Sub-workflow
nodes.rationale: 4-node sub-workflow: Assemble row (adds generation_id, output_image_path), Upload PNG to Supabase Storage, Insert generation row, Build gen response with all fields.

nodes.label: wf_enhance_caption Sub-workflow
nodes.rationale: 7-node workflow. Fetches reference image, calls OpenRouter vision LLM, parses ===CAPTION=== (3-5 sentence description) and ===SPATIAL=== (JSONB) blocks, PATCHes reference_images with caption_enhanced and spatial_signature.

nodes.label: wf_event_log Sub-workflow
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget POST to Supabase /rest/v1/events. Input: {event_type, user_id?, session_id?, payload?}. Uses neverError:true so logging failures never block the caller.

nodes.label: Google Gemini Image Generation
nodes.rationale: Agent 3 in the orchestrated pipeline. Model ID fetched from app_config at request time (not hard-coded). Generates designed-room image from prompt + upload + 3 reference images.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Chat Completions (Orchestrator)
nodes.rationale: Used by Agent 1 and Agent 2 for multimodal reasoning. Uses chat/completions with image_url content. Model: google/gemini-2.5-flash (orch_model config key).

nodes.label: Nemotron VL 1B v2 Embeddings
nodes.rationale: Used for legacy retrieve_references endpoint. Returns 2048-dim embeddings. Input must be array of strings [dataUri] or [promptText, dataUri]. Multiple inputs averaged into single query vector.

nodes.label: JWT Gate Pattern (Auth on Every Endpoint)
nodes.rationale: Every authed endpoint: Verify JWT Code â†’ Token valid? IF â†’ Respond 401 on false. Implemented as wf_supabase_verify sub-workflow call. Exceptions: /health and /admin/metrics.
nodes.norm_label: jwt gate pattern (auth on every endpoint)

nodes.label: WFSYNC Auto-sync Documentation System
nodes.rationale: PostToolUse hook runs sync_workflow_docs.py after Write/Edit. Replaces content between <!-- WFSYNC:stem:START --> and <!-- WFSYNC:stem:END --> markers in WORKFLOW_SYSTEM.md from workflow JSONs.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend Implementation Plan (Phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Original plan for Phase 2 FastAPI backend (superseded by n8n approach). Includes CLIP ViT-B/32 retrieval, Gemini generation, A/B harness, pgvector search. 16 implementation steps, ~11h estimate.

nodes.label: CLIP ViT-B/32 Retrieval (Phase 2 Plan)
nodes.rationale: 512-dim CLIP embeddings used in Phase 2 plan. Filters by room_type + style_tags, orders by embedding <=> query (pgvector cosine). Superseded by Nemotron 2048-dim + FTS approach in n8n.

nodes.label: A/B Model Testing Harness
nodes.rationale: Script testing model configs across rooms x styles. 120 drafts (6 rooms x 6 styles x 2 configs), 20 full flows. Outputs metrics.csv and report.html with paired thumbnails.

nodes.label: n8n Task Runner Sandbox env Block
nodes.rationale: n8n task runner sandbox blocks $env and process.env in Code nodes by default. Fix: set N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false as Windows user environment variable and restart n8n.
nodes.norm_label: n8n task runner sandbox env block

nodes.label: ns::Config Code Node Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every branch that calls external APIs gets a Config Code node right after the webhook trigger. Reads all env vars into $json._cfg. HTTP nodes reference config as $('ns::Config').first().json._cfg.key.

nodes.label: build_consolidated.py Workflow Merge Script
nodes.rationale: Python script merging 17 source workflows (13 main + 4 shared) into one 220-node consolidated JSON. Validates unique node names, IDs, and zero executeWorkflow nodes remaining.

nodes.label: Full Audit Report (2026-04-28)
nodes.rationale: CodeRabbit audit of all n8n workflows, DB migrations, frontend. 17 findings: 3 Critical (hardcoded secrets, .env not gitignored), 5 High (missing HTTP status codes, onReceived mode), 6 Medium, 3 Low. Overall score 6.8/10.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Secrets Security Finding (C-01)
nodes.rationale: Critical: retrieve_references.json and generate_draft.json hardcode Supabase key, Gemini key, OpenRouter key, JWT secret, admin token. Committed to git history. All keys must be rotated.

nodes.label: Webhook Endpoint Mapping
nodes.rationale: Maps 12 workflow files to webhook paths and frontend call sites. All endpoints at /webhook/ base. /generate/orchestrated was initially unused in frontend but is now the PRIMARY generation path.

nodes.label: Database Migration Audit
nodes.rationale: Migrations 004-011. Active function is 011_retrieve_references_fuzzy_and_tiered.sql. Migrations 007/009/010 superseded. retrieve_references RPC signature: (q TEXT, room_type TEXT, style_tag TEXT, k INTEGER, prompt TEXT DEFAULT NULL).

nodes.label: Progressive Web App Service Worker
nodes.rationale: Registers /sw.js service worker for offline capability. Configured with manifest.json for installable PWA with apple-mobile-web-app-capable meta tag.
